work.note: A referência é a música que ensina verbos irregulares: bought, came, got. facts.label: Passado: dia de chuva
facts.sub: Use rained, stayed, made, ran e won para contar o dia. Pergunte Did you go out? Who won? e responda It rained all morning, so I stayed home.

facts.label: Dia de chuva
facts.sub: Em dias chuvosos, as pessoas ficam em casa e fazem coisas tranquilas: cozinhar, ler, jogar. Use It rained all morning, so I stayed home para contar o dia em duas frases.

facts.label: Guarda-chuva

pages.title: A cozy apartment · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday afternoon in a cozy apartment in Seattle. Gray clouds cover the sky. Warm lamps make the room golden. Rui arrives with a wet jacket. Nora takes his umbrella and smiles. She asks about his rainy morning.
“Hi, Rui! Come in, you’re all wet.” says Nora. “Thanks. It rained all morning, so I stayed home.” says Rui. “What did you do?” says Nora.
